desc: Derive and verify the criterion: a divisor \(d\) is feasible for \(A_i\) iff \(d\mid A_i\) and its global multiple count is at least \(K\).
Implement frequency counting, multiples-count sieve, and descending assignment of the largest feasible divisor for each occurring value.
Use optimized Python input/output and memory-conscious arrays suitable for \(N\leq1.2\times10^6\).
Run and verify against all provided sample cases.
